property: The textual Internet mail message format is formally revised while retaining the RFC 822-descended header/body model and compatibility-oriented parsing of historical syntax.

date_or_range.notes: RFC 5322 explicitly says it revises RFC 2822, which itself superseded RFC 822.

sources.supports: formal RFC 2822→5322 revision and RFC 822 ancestry

negative_claims: This is message-syntax lineage, not SMTP transport lineage.
MIME is an extension layer over message representation, not the same revision chain.
open_questions: Create structured RFC 822 and RFC 2822 source/artifact records.
notes: Stored historical mail makes backward grammar knowledge operationally important long after old documents are superseded.
